notes:
Indicates the commencement of work, classes, or business operations. Composed of {始|し} (begin) and {業|ぎょう} (work, business). Used in both workplace and school settings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {始業|しぎょう}{時間|じかん}: starting time
- {始業式|しぎょうしき}: opening ceremony (for a school term)
- {始業|しぎょう}ベル: start-of-class bell
- {始業|しぎょう}{前|まえ}: before the start of work/class

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {終業|しゅうぎょう}: end of work/class — the opposite
- {開業|かいぎょう}: opening a business — starting a new business or practice
- {就業|しゅうぎょう}: working, employment — refers to being engaged in work in general
